### POST /api/v1/backups/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `backups_create` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/backups/` |
| Business purpose | Add (backups). Back up the database and the documents now. Takes a few seconds on a developer PC. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-OPS-009](../../../requirements/platform-and-operations.md#hims-ops-009) |
| Actor / permission required | `recovery.manage` (Make a backup (a full copy of all records and documents) and run restore drills). System roles holding it: Organization administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session; a "confirm it's you" within the last 15 minutes is required |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | No body |
| Response schema | 201 `Backup` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | Not taken: repeating the request is refused by the state rules or is harmless |
| Concurrency control | No version check (adds a new record or is a one-off action); unique rules in the database refuse duplicates |
| Database transaction | Each statement on its own (no multi-row change); the audit event is saved with it |
| Audit event | `recovery.backup.created` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | PostgreSQL tools (pg_dump / pg_restore) on the database server |
| Timeout and retry policy | PostgreSQL tools run with a time limit; a failure is `RECOVERY_FAILED`; the client should reload before retrying a lost answer |
| Expected error codes | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 403 `REAUTH_REQUIRED`, 409 `RECOVERY_FAILED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/recovery/tests/test_restore_drill.py::test_backup_then_restore_drill_proves_records_audit_and_documents_came_back`, `apps/recovery/tests/test_restore_drill.py::test_only_on_a_developer_pc`, `apps/recovery/tests/test_restore_drill.py::test_auditors_see_the_evidence_but_cannot_make_backups_or_drills` |
| Backward-compatibility policy | API v1 rules in [the API contracts guide](../README.md#versioning-and-breaking-changes); CI fails when `docs/api/openapi.yaml` differs from the code |
